basic_details.job_title: MPKV Rahuri Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agricultural Engineering, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri has invited applications for two Young Professional-II posts, one in Plant Protection and one in IT, under the ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research, Nagpur funded project "Development of AI-aided Early Warning and Realtime Monitoring System and UAV-aided Precision Pest Management Strategies". The posts are purely temporary and contractual, with a fixed pay of Rs. 42000/- per month. The filled application form with self-attested photocopies of documents must be sent by post or courier on or before 3

how_to_apply: Download the application format and other information from the website https://mpkv.ac.in. The format is also printed with the notice.

Fill in the form with full details: post applied, personal details, educational qualification starting from 10th class, work experience, publication numbers, present employment details and additional information.
Sign the declaration on the form and paste a recent self-attested passport size photo.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates and documentary evidence, and the no objection certificate from the current employer if employed.

Send the application by post or courier service to: Principal Investigator, Development of AI-aided Early Warning and Realtime Monitoring System and UAV-aided Precision Pest Management Strategies, Department of Agricultural Engineering, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, Tal. Rahuri, Dist. Ahilyanagar - 413722 (MS).
Send it on or before 30/11/2026 (up to 6.00 pm). Applications submitted by email will not be considered.
Self-attested photocopies of certificates and documentary evidence for qualification, work experience and additional information.
No objection certificate from the current employer.
List of publications, with copies of full-length papers.
Self-attested passport size photo on the form.

No additional documents are accepted separately, either before or after the last date or at the interview. The notice gives the office phone number 02426-243268 and the office email [email protected].
important_instructions: The posts are purely temporary and contractual. The selected candidate cannot claim regular appointment or absorption in MPKV or ICAR. Non-maintenance of discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties make the Young Professional-II liable for termination during the appointment period as per ICAR rules. Selected candidates must produce all original documents and certificates at the time of joining. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. The Selection Committee reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the positions, and to select no candidate or scrap any position even after the interview. The Young Professional-II works full time on the project and may not hold another appointment, with or without remuneration, elsewhere. The attendance register may be kept by the Co-PI/PI. The Young Professional-II works under the administrative control of the Co-Principal Investigator and Principal Investigator, and may have to work anywhere in the jurisdiction of MPKV as the need arises. Services can be ended on 24 hours' notice for negligence or misconduct. Leaving mid-tenure needs one month's written notice or payment of one month's salary. Leaving without permission for one month ends the engagement from the date of absence. Research work done in the project is the property of the project. The PI alone decides whether the incumbent's name is acknowledged in a research paper.

content_sections.heading: About MPKV
content_sections.text: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is a Government of Maharashtra institution at Rahuri, Tal. Rahuri, Dist. Ahilyanagar. This notice is issued from the office of the project at the CAAST Building, Central Campus, MPKV, Rahuri. The project is funded by ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research, Nagpur, and the posts sit in the Department of Agricultural Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit for both posts is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years, with relaxation as per rules. The application form asks for age as on 30/11/2026. The notice does not print the relaxation amounts for any category. Essential: Master's degree in Agriculture Entomology/Plant Pathology. Desirable: Experience in the identification of major crop insects pests, diseases, and physiological disorders in the field. Essential: Graduates with at least 60% marks in Computer Application/Information Technology/Computer Science and Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence and Data Science/Software Engineering with one year experience in the relevant field. OR Master in Computer Application/Information Technology/Computer Science and Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence and Data Science/Software Engineering. Desirable: Experience in AI/ML models for crop analytics, pest/disease detection. Desirable: Experience in AI architecture, data standards, DL/ML algorithms for detection and mapping of insect, pest and diseases. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry Rs. 42000/- per month (Fixed). The engagement is initially for six months, which may be extended subject to the performance of the Young Professional-II in the project. The appointment ends on completion of the project tenure or on the date stated in the appointment order, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate must execute a bond on Rs. 100/- bond paper in the format provided from time to time. The notice mentions no allowance on top of the fixed pay.

Rahuri, Dist. Ahilyanagar - 413722 (MS). Send it on or before 30/11/2026 (up to 6.00 pm). Applications submitted by email will not be considered. Documents named in the notice: Self-attested photocopies of certificates and documentary evidence for qualification, work experience and additional information. No objection certificate from the current employer. List of publications, with copies of full-length papers. Self-attested passport size photo on the form. No additional documents are accepted separately, either before or after the last date or at the interview. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised for eligibility. Candidates are then short-listed on academic qualification, experience, publication, achievements/awards and similar details given in the application form, submitted with a no objection certificate from the current employer. Only short-listed candidates are called for the interview. The interview date will be communicated to eligible candidates separately by email or text message. The notice also asks candidates to visit www.mpkv.ac.in for updates. The interview date is not printed in the notice. Candidates should bring a photo identity for the "Verification of Document" process or interview/written examination. No TA/DA/remuneration is paid for attending the interview or joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 post of Young Professional-II (Plant Protection) and 1 post of Young Professional-II (IT).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MPKV Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: The application must be sent on or before 30 November 2026 (up to 6.00 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Young Professional-II (Plant Protection)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Agriculture Entomology/Plant Pathology. Experience in identifying major crop insect pests, diseases and physiological disorders in the field is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Young Professional-II (IT)?
faq.answer: Graduates with at least 60% marks in a listed computing or AI discipline and one year of relevant experience, OR a Master in the listed disciplines, are eligible. The disciplines are Computer Application, Information Technology, Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence (including AI and Machine Learning, and AI and Data Science) and Software Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPKV Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The age limit is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years for both posts. Relaxation is given as per rules, and the notice prints no relaxation amounts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of Young Professional-II at MPKV?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42000/- per month (Fixed) for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MPKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application format from https://mpkv.ac.in, attach self-attested photocopies of documents, and send it by post or courier to the Principal Investigator at the Department of Agricultural Engineering, MPKV, Rahuri. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and candidates are short-listed on academic qualification, experience, publication and achievements/awards given in the form. Short-listed candidates are then called for an interview, and the date is sent by email or text message.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MPKV Young Professional-II job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely temporary and contractual. The initial engagement is six months, which may be extended subject to performance, and there is no claim to regular appointment or absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA/remuneration is paid for attending the interview or joining, if selected.
